mutations.name: NB-OFF
mutations._mechanism: no group ever collapses: nested evidence counts as findings again (must=27 vs 3)
mutations.find: return not any(_is_acknowledged(p, acknowledged) for p, _c in flat)

mutations.name: NB-ONE
mutations._mechanism: one space past the parent counts as nesting: a stray-space sibling is swallowed

mutations.name: NB-LABEL
mutations._mechanism: a short Label: parent collapses its children, which are the findings

mutations.name: NB-CLOSE
mutations._mechanism: prose or a numbered item at parent depth no longer ends the nesting (review MED)

mutations.name: NB-MEAS
mutations._mechanism: an early measurement parent collapses its build children into measurement-only musts (review 3)
mutations.find: if cls == "measurement" and any(c != "measurement" for _p, c in _flat_findings(group["lines"])):

mutations.name: NB-ACK
mutations._mechanism: an acked parent collapses and clears its unacked children (review 1 HIGH)
mutations.find: return not any(_is_acknowledged(p, acknowledged) for p, _c in flat)
mutations.replace: return not any(_is_acknowledged(p, acknowledged) for p, _c in flat[1:])

mutations.name: NB-ACKCHILD
mutations._mechanism: an acked build child folds into an unacked parent and loses its ack refusal
mutations.find: return not any(_is_acknowledged(p, acknowledged) for p, _c in flat)
mutations.replace: return not any(_is_acknowledged(p, acknowledged) for p, _c in flat[:1])

_note: Guards with no row, kept deliberately as second layers: the none_child guard, the depth/late half of the class check, and the one-class-line check. Each blocks a class downgrade that NB-MEAS's rule ('a collapse never yields more measurement than the flat rule') already blocks: a late, second or deep class line always leaves some flat finding untagged, so flat has a build and the collapse is forced to build. A mutant of one of these layers alone therefore survives by design (measured 2026-10-02: NB-LATE, NB-MULTI and NB-DEPTH survived once NB-MEAS landed). Do not delete them as redundant: the overlap is the point.
